current_behavior:
**Surfaces.** Staff sell through FOUR paths: (1) COUNTER MODE = the customer SPA with `SHG_BOOT.staff` present (index.php:93-131 adds it for any admin session; `?counter=1` is only a URL marker, nothing server-side reads it). app.template.html:153 loads 14-counter.js for every visitor; it no-ops without `SHG_BOOT.staff` (14-counter.js:29-31). (2) QUICKBOT admin/quick-ticket.php → api/quick-ticket.php `sell` → QuickTicket::sell (quickticket.php:717-815). (3) SEAT MAP walk-in pane admin/seatmap.php:886-905 → seatmap_counter_book (seatmap.php:51-96). (4) legacy admin/new-booking.php?legacy=1 (BookingService::counterSale). All four end in BookingService::create($request,$seller) except (4). Verified locally (curl as superadmin): `/admin/new-booking.php?route=1&date=2026-10-05` → 302 `index.php?counter=1&from=Ahmedabad&to=Nepalgunj&date=2026-10-05#/`.

**(1) Agent selection today.** index.php:110-127 ships `staff.agents` = active `role='agent'` rows that hold an SHG code (code/name/type/co), sorted by code; `staff.code` = the seller's own code or null (index.php:101). Local payload for superadmin: `code: null, agents:[{SHG-0001 "Agent One (demo)"}]`. In decorateCheckout (14-counter.js:380-420, commit 41a80d0) the static `<input id="cAgentCode">` (app.template.html:1985-1997) is replaced ONCE by a `<select>` (options: blank "Select Agent", each agent, `OTHER`), moved under the Cash/UPI/eSewa/Bank chips inside `#ctrPanel`, and on later renders is left alone ("keep the desk's choice across re-renders", line 394-395) — so the choice survives sale after sale WITHIN the tab. Default = the staff's own code only if they have one (`selected` at line 402); otherwise blank, and validateCheckoutDetails (07-checkout.js:225-230) + coSyncContinue (275-278) refuse the sale until picked. Nothing persists the pick: on reload/new tab the select is rebuilt blank (CTR.pay 'cash' also resets, line 38). submitBooking does call `persistAgentCode(agentCodeInput)` → localStorage `shg_agent_code` (07-checkout.js:1208, 03-accounts.js:89-94), but 14-counter.js never reads it; it only feeds agentSearchCode() for departed-bus searches (and will store the literal "OTHER"). hookApi (14-counter.js:570-611) posts `counterPayment, agentCode, discountType/Value, note` on top of submitBooking's payload (api/book.php:110-148 — agentCode wins, seller built from the SESSION). Server (booking.php:178-194): `sold_by_admin_id = staff id`, typed code kept as `$deskAgentCode`; after commit (booking.php:668-680) Ticket::issue → AgentWallet::accrue (commission + cash_due rows for the STAFF, commission_agent_only default OFF, agentwallet.php:1369-1371) → attributeDeskSale (booking.php:708-742) resolves the picked code, else `company_agent_code` (SHG-0001), and reassignSeller moves the commission rows to that agent (cash_due stays with the desk; Ticket::reissue with atSale so REV stays 0). A desk that is itself `role='agent'` skips attribution and keeps its own sale. QuickBot has the same mandatory `#qtAgent` select (quick-ticket.php:439-447, validate 841) → quickticket.php:764,797 passes it as referralCode. Seat-map walk-in has NO agent field (seatmap.php:886-905) → always credited to the company code.

**Passenger details retention.** Seat view gets a staff-only `#ctrQuick` Name/Mobile line (14-counter.js:543-567); a capture-phase click on `#continueBtn` writes `window.SHG_QUICK={name,phone}`; renderCheckout (07-checkout.js:781-791) fills the lead name + `#cPhone` (+gender/age if present — ctrQuick sends none). decorateCheckout blanks `#cPhone/#cEmail/#idNum/#ctrDiscVal/#ctrNote` once per new draft id and then re-puts SHG_QUICK.phone (14-counter.js:255-274); after a sale `forgetPassenger()` clears SHG_QUICK and the quick inputs (604, 116-119) — by design the desk never inherits the previous passenger (owner, 6 Sep). All repeat-customer prefills (PaxMemory, saved contact, CheckoutDraft restore, USER name/phone, country picker) are disabled for staff via isCounterSale() (07-checkout.js:15-17, 94, 103, 118, 512, 725, 753-758, 773, 801); ensureCustomerSession returns early for staff (08-signin.js:140); start() calls setUser(null) (14-counter.js:704). Boarding/drop come from the seat view selects, which are re-filled with the route's defaults on every renderSeats (06-results.js:855-859) — not remembered per desk (QuickBot DOES remember boarding + pay in localStorage: quick-ticket.php:603-604,637,655). On a failed submit the flow returns to step 1 with everything intact (07-checkout.js:1155-1157; 14-counter.js:525-532).

**(2) After a sale.** api/book.php returns `counter:true, adminUrl`; hookApi stores CTR.last {from,to,date,sid,rid} in memory (14-counter.js:595-603) and patches the local record. decorateStatus (627-645) adds: "🚌 Same bus · next ticket" (only if CTR.last is set), "🧾 Sell another" (href `#/`, resets Flow, keeps the static search inputs but requires tapping Search again), "Open in panel", "Back to panel". sameBus() (654-678) re-runs the same from/to/date search and autoPick(sid,'',rid) clicks the matching card at once → seat map with fresh occupancy (SeatSrv invalidated at 07-checkout.js:1317). There is no "same date, choose a different bus" action, and CTR.last dies on reload. QuickBot "Next ticket" (quick-ticket.php:987-992) hides the result and keeps direction/date/boarding/seats/pay/agent chips; name/phone/discount/note are cleared (885-887).

**(3) Clicks / screens.** Deep link (agent.php:1486, seatmap.php:889, new-booking redirect, 14-counter.js:165-204 prefill → auto-submits search; autoPick only when `&sid`/`&seat` given): link → results → card tap (autoSkip to seats only on a fresh search with exactly one bookable card, 06-results.js:256-260) → seat tap(s) or "How many seats?" → type name(+phone) → Continue → "Confirm counter sale" (ctrConfirm = coGoStep(2)+real submit, 14-counter.js:509-533; T&C auto-accepted, phone optional 8-15 digits, cash chip default, agent select, discount, note all on step 1) → ticket. ≈5 taps, 4 views. From "+ New Booking" nav: + direction/town/date/Search ≈8 taps. QuickBot: type name(+mobile) → one Confirm (agent pre-selected only if the staff has a code). Seat map walk-in: route/date → seat menu "Book walk-in / cash" (seatmap.php:1181, prefillCounter) → name/gender/phone → Book seat + confirm dialog; one seat, cash only, no boarding, no agent. Prefills: from/to/date/sid/seat from the URL (route endpoint cities, which populateCitySelects puts in #fromSel/#toSel, 05-router.js:431-444); agent = own code; payment = cash; maxSeats 20 (14-counter.js:47-50); boarding/drop = route defaults.

**(4) Gating.** canSell = bookings.edit || schedules.edit || superadmin (index.php:102, api/book.php:29, Auth::isSellingStaff auth.php:897-903) → superadmin, manager, counter, agent sell; accountant/support/scanner/official get the bar in "view only" (14-counter.js:66) and a 403 on counterPayment (api/book.php:119-121). admin pages: new-booking/quick-ticket/agent.php/bookings/shift/booking-view `bookings.view`; quick-ticket's Confirm disabled unless isSellingStaff (quick-ticket.php:450); seatmap `schedules.view`, its POST `schedules.edit` (seatmap.php:~144), assign_agent superadmin (183-187); agent-assign.php `commissions.view` + counter agent refused + superadmin to change (agent-assign.php:16-25, 54); booking-view reassign superadmin (786); nav hides Assign Agents from agents (_guard.php:103). Counter agents are data-scoped by bookingScopeAdminId (auth.php:923-926).
